title: Terry Lovelace hears a being's voice telepathically

tellings.quote: I remember Terry LEL talking about this when he met Betty Rubble he just heard her voice in his head in the same voice

plain: A man named Terry Lovelace says that when he met a non-human being he called "Betty Rubble", he heard her voice inside his head rather than through his ears. A guest named Mike Masters relays this to Michels, remembering Lovelace describing it, as an example of beings said to speak by telepathy.
